recommendation_en: When mother’s own milk and donor human milk are not available, nutrient-enriched preterm formula may be considered for very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very low-birth-weight (< 1.5 kg) infants. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendation_zh: 当母亲自身的母乳和捐赠人乳不可用时，可考虑为极早产（< 32周妊娠）或极低出生体重（< 1.5公斤）的婴儿使用营养强化早产儿配方奶粉。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）
